name: 精致 SaaS 工作台
positioning: 适合客户成功、订阅运营、续约管理和轻商务 SaaS 产品类网页 Demo
visual_reference: Sneat Bootstrap HTML Admin Template Free

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system geometric sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts
design_tokens.shadow_style: floating white cards with soft violet-gray shadows

layout_rules: Place a floating white sidebar inside a pale lavender canvas with rounded outer edges.
Use polished white cards, 12–16px radii, subtle shadows, lavender chips, and small avatar groups.
Use a welcome banner with original CSS shapes and a renewal pipeline board as signature components.
Use a refined account table and a rounded right drawer for context-preserving account details.
Every sidebar item opens one complete mutually exclusive page; mobile uses a web off-canvas sidebar.
interaction_contracts: Navigation switches complete pages exclusively and updates aria-current, breadcrumb, title, hash, focus, and scroll position.
Horizon tabs recalculate the visible revenue forecast and trend chart.
Account keyword, status, and segment filters plus reset update table rows, counts, and a truthful empty state.
CSV export downloads the current filtered account state with nonempty headers and data rows.
The account drawer binds to the selected account; confirmed renewal progression updates metrics, table, pipeline, team load, and notifications.
Member invitation validates name, role, and work email before adding a team member.
Settings save in-memory preferences and restore the packaged defaults with visible state changes.
Drawer and dialogs support Escape, explicit cancel and close paths, focus containment, and focus restoration.

preserve: chips, tabs, avatar groups, and pipeline board
replace_from_development_document: renewal state transitions and confirmation rules
metrics, chart, table, pipeline, notifications, members, settings, and synthetic mock data
avoid: Sneat logos, screenshots, brand copy, illustrations, fonts, source code, or premium-only components

single_file_compilation.asset_policy: inline SVG and CSS shapes only; no external URLs
